steps.prompt:
Edit this photo: make it evening. Make only these concrete changes:
1. The foreground floor near the camera falls into soft shadow, because the street behind the camera is now dark.
2. Overall exposure is about one stop darker; the ceiling and white surfaces become dimmer and warmer.
3. The three black dome pendant lamps over the counter are clearly switched on: bright warm bulbs visible inside, warm cones of light falling onto the counter top and onto the blue tiles below them.
4. The wall sconces on the right glow and cast warm light onto the wall.
5. Warm tungsten colour temperature overall, with deep blacks.
Keep everything else identical: same camera, framing, architecture, objects, people and materials. Do not change any text, sign, sack, logo or the flag. Do not add anything.
Photorealistic interior photograph, portrait 3:4.

branding_restoration.method: Real base-photo pixels pasted over AI-rendered regions: base upscaled to output width, position found by grayscale NCC search, per-channel colour statistics matched to the edit, feathered rectangular mask. Regions in base coordinates (x0,y0,x1,y1).
branding_restoration.note: The model garbled every text and turned the shelf plaque into an invented helmet; all five regions restored from the base photo. The plaque used colour statistics from a wider context box because its target region was an invented object.

assets.known_limits: Coffee bags on the back shelf keep AI-garbled small text; two real helmets on the back shelf remain, barely visible; the hook-rack helmet by the door was removed by the cleanup; original framing (shutter edge at the top).

steps.prompt:
Edit this photo: make it evening. Make only these concrete changes:
1. The street seen through the glass storefront on the left becomes dusk: deep blue evening light, street lamps on, the trees darker.
2. Inside, overall exposure is about one stop darker; the ceiling and the white tiled wall become dimmer and warmer.
3. The black dome pendant lamps are clearly switched on: bright warm bulbs visible inside, warm light falling onto the counter top, the wood slats and the blue tiles.
4. Warm tungsten colour temperature inside, with deep blacks and soft shadows.
Keep everything else identical: same camera, framing, architecture, objects, people and materials. Do not change any text, sign or logo. Do not add anything.
Photorealistic interior photograph, portrait 3:4.

branding_restoration.method: Real base-photo pixels pasted over AI-rendered regions: base upscaled to output width, position found by grayscale NCC search, per-channel colour statistics matched to the edit, feathered rectangular mask. Regions in base coordinates (x0,y0,x1,y1).
branding_restoration.note: Large mirrored lettering on the storefront glass was removed in the cleanup, not restored.

assets.known_limits: Small price tag remains at the top right; the street lamp seen through the glass was probably added by the light step; no helmets in frame (L17).
